Base64 Encoder / Decoder

Encode text to Base64 or decode Base64 back to text, with full UTF-8 support and a file-to-data-URL converter.


  

  

    
    
  

  

  
Encoding handles full UTF-8 text (emoji included). Files are converted to data URLs in your browser — nothing is uploaded.




  
  


  

    

      
📖 How to use

      
  1. Choose the Encode or Decode mode.
  2. Type or paste your text, or pick a file to convert to a data URL.
  3. Click Convert to see the result.
  4. Copy the result to your clipboard.

    

    

      
❓ Frequently asked questions

      
Does it handle emoji and non-English text?
Yes. Encoding uses a UTF-8 path (TextEncoder), so emoji and non-English text round-trip correctly — plain btoa alone would corrupt them.
What happens with invalid Base64 input?
You will get a clear validation error naming the problem, instead of silent garbage output.
How does the file to Base64 option work?
Pick a file and the tool converts it to a data URL entirely in your browser. Nothing is uploaded to any server.
